subject: *: support system variable `tidb_index_lookup_pushdown_policy` and hint `NO_INDEX_LOOKUP_PUSHDOWN` (#64932)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent (parser/planner/sessionctx). The new sysvar is an enum with explicit allowed values (hint-only/affinity-force/force) and is cleanly wired into access-path selection and PhysicalIndexLookUpReader pushdown attempts; warnings are suppressed for sysvar-driven attempts but retained for hint-driven inapplicability. The NO_INDEX_LOOKUP_PUSHDOWN hint is parsed, validated (rejects index args with warning), and correctly overrides both sysvar auto-force and INDEX_LOOKUP_PUSHDOWN. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, session/txn constraints, or planner behavior. Checked later history up to upstream/master for follow-up fixes to the new var/hint and found none.
